scripts.setup:ai:win: cd tools\ai-hedge-fund && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -U pip poetry && .venv\Scripts\python -m poetry env use .venv\Scripts\python.exe && .venv\Scripts\python -m poetry install --no-interaction && cd ..\stock-analysis && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:ai:linux: cd tools/ai-hedge-fund && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -U pip poetry && .venv/bin/python -m poetry env use "$(pwd)/.venv/bin/python" && .venv/bin/python -m poetry install --no-interaction && cd ../stock-analysis && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:aegean:win: cd tools/aegean-consensus && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:aegean:linux: cd tools/aegean-consensus && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
